response.original_title: ((Room⇁Inclusion)) How do I add a room to my Seabourn Cruise Line?
response.overview: To add a room on my Seabourn Cruise Line, call Customer Service directly at ☎【+1-866-829-1280 (US)】 or ☎【+44-204-586-5316 (UK)】 or 【+61-1800-009-384 (AUS)】 or reach out to your travel advisor. Because each cabin requires its own booking, an agent will set up a new, ☎【+1-866-829-1280 (US)】separate reservation. Make sure to ask them to officially link your booking numbers so your group shares the same main dining table and scheduled activities. To add a room to your Seabourn Cruise Line booking, contact ☎【+1-866-829-1280 (US)】 or ☎【 +44-204-586-5316 (UK)】Seabourn Cruise Line or your travel advisor as soon as possible.
